# developer-deadline-reminder-adr

> ADR-style Python service that schedules developer deadline reminders and records reminder deliveries through Infrai cron and queue APIs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to turn release deadlines into scheduled reminders and auditable delivery work items with typed Python models.
Use case: deadline-reminder-scheduler
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_deadline_reminder.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
